bench_e2e_routing_poc.title: Cold persisted 8-Mbp segment routing POC
bench_e2e_routing_poc.description: Benchmark-only 8-Mbp segment-routing feasibility sweep. Router-decision timing excludes the separately timed coverage analysis. Whole-segment byte metrics are batch-union upper bounds; one explicit full-scan fallback makes that upper bound 100% by design. Separate directory-range partition-touch metrics assign each query only to its selected segments. Primary truth is maximum overlap, material overlap is >=max(k,ceil(1% truth span)), and adversarial ambiguity explicitly full-scans. Full 2/4-Gbp global max-occ sizing and production-loader acceptance remain blocked; the small repeat is candidate-fixture-only. No Paper-ntHash compatibility or performance claim is made.

test_case_descriptions.ROUTING_2GBP_DNA4: 2 Gbp dna4 production-shape routing trial; Exact minimap hash scheme only
test_case_descriptions.ROUTING_2GBP_DNA5: 2 Gbp dna5 trial using the Exact-SIMD DNA5 N-reset contract; Exact minimap hash scheme only
test_case_descriptions.ROUTING_4GBP_DNA4: 4 Gbp dna4 production-shape routing trial; Exact minimap hash scheme only
test_case_descriptions.ROUTING_4GBP_DNA5: 4 Gbp dna5 trial using the Exact-SIMD DNA5 N-reset contract; Exact minimap hash scheme only
test_case_descriptions.ROUTING_BOUNDARY_DENSITY_64M_DNA4: Forced exact balanced-boundary and sub-material sliver queries plus generated queries
test_case_descriptions.ROUTING_DUPLICATED_SEGMENTS_64M_DNA4: Six byte-identical 8-Mbp segments and one exact local query; >4-way ambiguity must full-scan
test_case_descriptions.ROUTING_TANDEM_LOW_COMPLEXITY_64M_DNA4: Six low-complexity segments and one exact local query; insufficient/ambiguous evidence must full-scan
test_case_descriptions.ROUTING_SHORT_LOCAL_HOMOLOGY_64M_DNA4: A 256-Kbp local region copied into six segments; >4-way ambiguity must full-scan
test_case_descriptions.ROUTING_GLOBAL_THRESHOLD_REPEAT_24M_DNA4: Bounded candidate-only fixture proving at least one hash is <=500 occurrences per segment but >500 globally; not full-scale global max-occ sizing
